weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 50% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 20/28 passes (71%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

players.headline: Outstanding forward performance (10.0, top 10% for the position) - best at getting shots off, finishing; work on shot selection, forcing passes.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Well, PhogsToffees, a 10.0 is the kind of night you tell your grandkids about. Top 10% of forwards, and you earned every bit.
coach.closer: That's the stuff. Same time next match?

push.title: W 9-1 vs Tuntuncitos FC | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #11)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 10.0. Perfect Game #11. I've been coaching a long time and I still got goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 11th Perfect Game for us. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ Goal involvements 8, up from your usual 2. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ 2 key passes. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ Man of the Match, your 26th for us. Top performer, top teammate.
+ Tackles won 3, up from your usual 1. That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- 4 of 8 shots on target. Coach's secret: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- 71% passing (20 of 28, down from your usual 79%). Back to basics: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle. Fix it and forget it.
- 3 tackles won: -0.2. Next rep, better rep.

Practice prescription: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

Keep writing those happy chapters. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 9-1 vs Tuntuncitos FC | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #6)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a perfect 10.0 against Tuntuncitos FC. Perfect Game #6. I don't have a speech for this. I'm just gonna stand here and clap.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 6th Perfect Game for us. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Goal involvements 8, up from your usual 2. You can build a whole match on that.
+ 1 key pass. You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ You found PhogsToffees and PhogsToffees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 2. Team wins are the best kind.

THE BAD
- Completed passes 13, down from your usual 22. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Here's the trick: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Training ground: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

BellyTb1, take this with you: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Let's do it again tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
